Risks.risk_1: Unavailability of requirements documents for testing
Risks.risk_10: Deficiencies in components provided by external agents
Risks.risk_13: Inadequate actors developing a certain task
Risks.risk_15: Communication failures between analysts and developers
Risks.risk_16: Adopted technology is inadequate for a certain task
Risks.risk_17: Test environment does not replicate production
Risks.risk_19: Existing structure is inadequate for performing tasks
Risks.risk_21: Incompetent or overly competent actors for given technology

RiskMitigations.risk_1: 1. Have a team representative at client site. 2. Involve testing team early.
RiskMitigations.risk_2: 1. Conduct workshops with stakeholders. 2. Define clear acceptance criteria. 3. Use prototypes for validation.
RiskMitigations.risk_3: 1. Establish formal change control process. 2. Assess timeline and cost impact before approval. 3. Review backlog frequently.
RiskMitigations.risk_4: 1. Detailed cost and schedule estimates from various sources. 2. Design according to cost. 3. Adopt Incremental development.
RiskMitigations.risk_5: 1. Define SLAs for decisions. 2. Delegate authority to the team. 3. Reduce approval steps.
RiskMitigations.risk_6: 1. Establish synchronization rituals. 2. Centralize decisions and logs. 3. Use official channels for changes.
RiskMitigations.risk_7: 1. Team working by job matching. 2. Cross-training. 3. Prepare an adequate pre-schedule.
RiskMitigations.risk_8: 1. Retention and recognition plan. 2. Continuous documentation. 3. Pair programming for knowledge transfer.
RiskMitigations.risk_9: 1. Training with client domain experts. 2. Follow-up with key users. 3. Review requirements with real examples.
RiskMitigations.risk_10: 1. Conduct comparative evaluation. 2. Perform inspections. 3. Perform compatibility analysis.
RiskMitigations.risk_11: 1. Automate pipelines with tests. 2. Monitor failures and durations. 3. Maintain supported versions.
RiskMitigations.risk_12: 1. Reserve capacity for refactoring. 2. Define quality criteria. 3. Review code periodically.
RiskMitigations.risk_13: 1. Train the development team. 2. Define tasks by individual skills. 3. Adopt flexible governance.
RiskMitigations.risk_14: 1. Balance workload distribution. 2. Create skill redundancy. 3. Monitor team capacity.
RiskMitigations.risk_15: 1. Joint requirement refinement. 2. Accessible and up-to-date documentation. 3. Short alignment meetings.
RiskMitigations.risk_16: 1. Adopt contingency models for software development. 2. Manage technology options.
RiskMitigations.risk_17: 1. Standardize infra with IaC. 2. Use similar data and configurations. 3. Load testing before releases.
RiskMitigations.risk_18: 1. Map integrations and contracts. 2. Create mocks for tests. 3. Establish API versioning.
RiskMitigations.risk_19: 1. Adapt decision structure. 2. Modify process model.
RiskMitigations.risk_20: 1. Define value-prioritized backlog. 2. Review priorities each cycle. 3. Make priority criteria explicit.
RiskMitigations.risk_21: 1. Prototype the product. 2. Technical process analysis. 3. Scenario techniques. 4. Technical training.
RiskMitigations.risk_22: 1. Hands-on training and tutorials. 2. Support during transition. 3. Demonstrate gains with metrics.
RiskMitigations.risk_23: 1. Apply appropriate leadership tactics. 2. Hire cooperative people with management skills. 3. Team building programs.
RiskMitigations.risk_24: 1. Define RACI and clear roles. 2. Mediate conflicts with leadership. 3. Log decisions and responsibilities.
RiskMitigations.risk_25: 1. Change authority or workflow. 2. Adopt/configure new organizational technologies.
RiskMitigations.risk_26: 1. Plan capacity with metrics. 2. Adopt horizontal scalability. 3. Continuously monitor performance.
